name: chitinase 1

function.text: CHIT1 is the approved symbol for chitinase 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in chitin binding; chitinase activity; carbohydrate metabolic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Colorectal carcinoma; Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: CHIT1 encodes chitinase 1. Its functions include chitin binding and chitinase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHIT1 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
